authorityMap.authority: Existing canonical mission truth and lifecycle writer
authorityMap.changePolicy: Reuse; no parallel mission state authority
Enforce server-derived identity and tenant scope

authorityMap.authority: Existing canonical capability and resource contract registries
authorityMap.changePolicy: Read and validate; do not duplicate definitions

authorityMap.authority: Existing governed execution coordinator and effect verification
authorityMap.changePolicy: No bypass; simulation has no physical effects
New immutable versions only; no live edits
Simulation records are evidence for tests, never mission truth

phases.summary: Introduce an eight-area searchable Control Plane entry point that routes to existing canonical workspaces without creating new domain authorities.
acceptance: Eight unique top-level areas map only to registered canonical workspaces.
Workspace intent search returns only known areas and never fabricates resources.
Role and tenant authorization remains enforced by backend authorities.
Deployed browser and full market-launch journey are verified before production certification.

phases.title: Canonical Resource Inventory Workbench
phases.summary: Add practical resource-type and lifecycle-status filters, honest result-scope disclosure, record refresh and identity-copy actions to the existing canonical Resource Management workspace.
exitCriteria: Type/status filters operate on the current canonical result set and clearly disclose their scope.
Selecting a result re-reads the resource from its owning canonical authority.
Resource 360 refresh re-reads canonical truth and copy action copies only the stable resource identity.
Browser tests verify filters, empty states, record refresh, dependency navigation and authorized lifecycle actions.
No duplicate lifecycle or resource authority is introduced.

phases.title: Super Admin Platform Results & Certification Center
exitCriteria: Read-only results center composes existing authorized evidence sources
Source availability is clearly distinct from functional and production certification
Unavailable and stale evidence remain visible as unavailable or unverified
Complete canonical mission journey is represented without inferred pass states
Per-mission event evidence and immutable cross-source certification history remain explicitly pending
No new domain authority, backend, mutation route or device actuation is introduced
Journey stage contracts identify existing authority, required evidence and acceptance invariants
Runtime stage status is never inferred from a display template or endpoint reachability

phases.title: Canonical mission journey certification contract
exitCriteria: All 16 canonical journey positions map to an existing authority and evidence contract
Predecessor ordering, idempotency, stale-write rejection, tenant scope and recovery are explicit test gates
Per-mission runtime status remains UNVERIFIED until authoritative events/evidence are linked
No duplicate mission state authority or lifecycle writer is introduced

phases.title: Simulation foundation and governed records
exitCriteria: Virtual scenarios and failure injection work
Run records are immutable and content-hashed
Simulation-only safety invariants are enforced

phases.title: Tenant-scoped simulation
exitCriteria: Tenant identity is derived server-side
Cross-tenant reads and writes are denied
Role boundaries are verified over authenticated HTTP

phases.title: Planning adapter and deterministic replay
exitCriteria: Scenario inputs are versioned
Replay detects altered outcomes and traces
Resource/deadline constraints block unsafe plans

phases.title: Virtual device safety profiles
exitCriteria: Versioned virtual device profiles enforce speed and payload limits
Physical connections, actuation, production mutation and device commands remain disabled
Planning-only profiles reject later execution stages

phases.title: Simulator browser and adversarial certification
exitCriteria: Authenticated Super Admin save/history/reload/replay is browser-tested
Tenant save/history/reload/replay is browser-tested
Cross-tenant denial and role authorization are verified
Failure handling and accessibility are reviewed
Deployment and runtime evidence is retained
Static adversarial contracts enforce server-derived tenant scope, role guards, platform/tenant record separation, immutable run records, replay conflict handling and simulation-only invariants
Authenticated browser and deployed HTTP evidence is attached before certification is marked complete

phases.title: Canonical planner integration and replay certification
exitCriteria: Actual canonical planning/evaluation outputs are consumed through read-only governed contracts
Resource constraints are tied to canonical contracts
Expected/observed outcome comparisons are reproducible
Deterministic certification harness validates canonical planning contract version and fail-closed constraints
No live mission plan is created or mutated by simulation certification

phases.title: Vendor simulation and software/hardware in the loop
exitCriteria: Vendor simulator contract and sandbox are approved
Software-in-the-loop passes device-specific safety tests
Hardware-in-the-loop remains disabled until explicit device safety certification
Vendor adapter is a deterministic local contract harness and has no production network or device credentials
SIL test fixtures exercise success, timeout, malformed response, safety-limit violation and loss of heartbeat
HIL actuation is hard-disabled until vendor/device-specific safety approval and supervised test evidence exist

phases.title: Germany logistics end-to-end certification
exitCriteria: Normal delivery is verified
Blocked assignment is safely handled
Failed delivery enters recovery
Evidence is checked independently
Final outcome and next situation are correct
Germany logistics scenarios cover normal delivery, blocked assignment, failed delivery/recovery and independent evidence verification
Scenario contract tests are deterministic and do not claim live customer, carrier or physical-delivery evidence

phases.title: Governed action orchestration
exitCriteria: Intent, plan, capability, risk, resources, authorization, execution, effects and verification use one governed path

phases.title: Unified Platform Control
exitCriteria: Operational blockers, resources, approvals, readiness and recovery are surfaced without duplicate authorities

phases.title: Infrastructure, data, experience and content centers
exitCriteria: Shared governed data and configuration workflows are reused across control centers

phases.title: Integration and AI capability centers
exitCriteria: Providers use versioned capability contracts, bounded permissions and verified effects

phases.title: Market Factory and tenant activation
exitCriteria: Market packages/releases are immutable, validated, authorized and verified
Tenant activation follows market and access readiness

phases.title: Certified real-world mission execution
exitCriteria: Controlled Germany logistics pilot passes safety, authorization, evidence and recovery gates

phases.title: Governed Human Execution Orchestration
phases.description: Connect human-executor orchestration to existing canonical mission, authorization, assignment, capability, action and recovery authorities.
exitCriteria: All consequential commands use existing canonical authorities
No parallel mission truth or lifecycle writer
Uncertain effect is reconciled or explicitly waiting

phases.title: Germany Logistics Pilot Contract
phases.description: Define bounded Germany logistics pilot scenarios, evidence requirements, custody boundaries, human roles and recovery rules.
exitCriteria: Bounded Germany delivery scenarios are versioned
Evidence and custody criteria are explicit
Fixtures are isolated from real customer operations

phases.title: End-to-End Human-Executor Mission Proof
phases.description: Exercise deterministic end-to-end normal and failure/recovery scenario contracts; keep live physical effects unverified until independently evidenced.
exitCriteria: Normal path and failure/recovery path pass deterministic contract harness
Every stage emits expected evidence requirements
No scenario claims physical delivery from simulation

phases.title: Controlled Pilot Readiness and Operational Approval
phases.description: Define controlled pilot readiness gates, explicit human approval requirements, stop conditions, incident response and rollback.
exitCriteria: All readiness gates have evidence or remain blocked
Authorized human approval is explicit and auditable
Stop conditions, incident handling and rollback are documented
